title: Methodology for Creating Surface Water Database Using Gis Tools and Remote Sensing
content: Although it seems obvious in today's era of digitization to have an electronic surface water database, as proven in earlier studies, there are still many shortcomings, errors, and a lack of updating spatial information about the hydrographic network despite its dynamic nature. The answer to the need for an up-to-date spatial water database com-bines GIS and remote sensing tools. Using the example of the Polish administration, this article synthesizes the structure of the surface water database. It develops a scheme for using geoinformation tools to automatically obtain information about the hydrographic network's course. The study also analyzed the optimization of remote sensing input im-ages of medium and low aerial ceiling.
